quote.text: For a general post-cleaning assessment of a demonstration bearing, inspection should cover: (1) raceways (inner and outer) for spalling, flaking, indentations, scoring, and wear patterns; (2) rolling elements for surface damage, cracking, and discoloration; (3) cage/retainer for deformation, cracks, wear, and looseness; (4) sealing/shielding and lubricant condition, including contamination and lubricant identity/specification/batch; (5) fits and seating surfaces (shaft and housing) for fretting, corrosion, and evidence of misalignment; (6) dimensional/clearance checks where applicable; and (7) general condition such as corrosion, discoloration/heat effects, and cleanliness.

claims.reason: Lists raceways, rolling elements, cage, sealing/lubricant, fits/seating, dimensional/clearance, and general condition inspection domains.

quote.text: Context factors relevant to any reuse consideration include: the bearing's service history and loading/speed environment; the assumed mounting misalignment (a teaching assumption here, not an observed cause); lubricant type, condition, and contamination; the intended application and its criticality; applicable model-specific acceptance criteria and thresholds; and any required authorization (e.g., aviation or reuse approval), which is not supplied here.
